zip_layout: Playgama upload root: index.html, bundled game.js, game.wasm, runtime-build.json, playgama-bridge-config.json, and assets/game.ntpack. index.html must sit at the archive root, not in a folder. Every file and folder name uses Latin characters only. The uploaded game must not exceed 300 MB inside the archive.

metadata.orientation: The supported orientation is declared in the draft and must match the build; the portal shows a rotate-device placeholder in the other one. A one-orientation game declares that one value, and device.supportedOrientations in playgama-bridge-config.json says the same thing.

sdk_policy.load_policy: The selected adapter is embedded into game.js and loads Playgama Bridge during web backend init; no universal wrapper.
sdk_policy.ads: bridge.advertisement.showInterstitial/showRewarded/showBanner; reward only on the rewarded state; a sticky banner is the one extra ad block the portal allows
sdk_policy.storage: bridge.storage v2 signatures (get(key, tryParseJson), set(key, value)) through wrapper only
